hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.go) golangci-lint fmt "$f";; esac; exit 0

jq -e '.stop_hook_active == true' >/dev/null && exit 0; command -v golangci-lint >/dev/null || exit 0; [ -n "$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" status --porcelain -- '*.go')" ] || exit 0; out=$(cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && golangci-lint run ./... 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; exit 2; }
